name: documentation_collection
notes: The Yjs CRDT columns for the rich description are excluded; the body flows through the collaborative-editor WebSocket channel. description_text (the plain-text projection) is included. page_added / page_removed reference the collection by aggregate_id and carry the page_id; the documentation_collection_pages junction is not a separate aggregate. A cross-collection move emits page_removed on the old collection and page_added on the new. update_collection_description_yjs (Yjs auto-save) and soft_delete_pages_in_collection (bulk cascade on teardown) are sync-audit-only and emit no events.
